meta.method: Best-for picks are grounded first in the vendor's own changelog/announcement positioning. Benchmarks are secondary and subjective; where a score disagrees with vendor positioning the disagreement is flagged. Scores are cited individually with source, link and date. Artificial Analysis figures are not republished in bulk (licensing — their terms forbid redistribution, and their competitive-product clause covers comparison sites). Vendor-reported numbers are labelled as such and lead. No composite score is computed from different sources. Community notes are a planned future phase and are not included.
meta.price_basis: API list prices in USD per million tokens (input/output), short-context standard tier unless noted. Subscription plans bundle models with usage limits and do not bill per token.

meta.sources_note: Vendor statements reached via secondary coverage quoting the vendor page are labelled as such in the sources arrays.
